authority: Owner/orchestrator answers through native question tool in this implementation turn

Kim_initialization.origin: Orchestrator-chosen from diagnosis probes, not source values
Kim_initialization.rule: Both must converge and agree; use primary endpoint. Retain refused zero-pair attempt.

binary_gate: Liquid-liquid miscibility. Retain 170 vapor witnesses separately; check each Kim vapor witness against the sign of its bubble-pressure residual. Sign mismatches are reported and do not stop the gate.
Jakobsen_scale: 0.10 times observed ratio for both observables at every state. Orchestrator choice within source 5-10 percent range, not source value or MEA-record precedent. Report group cost at endpoints.
reaction_domain: Application upper bounds 395.0 K for R1-R3 and MDEA dissociation; coefficients and lower bounds unchanged. Record 2 K extrapolation plus original MDEA-law extrapolation above 368 K.
Merkley_roles: Move 20/40 wt percent markers at 288.71 and 422.04 K out of fit; report those and same-temperature 60 wt percent markers as extrapolation comparisons, unevaluated if Engine refuses. Fit 20/40 wt percent at 333.15 and 388.71 K; retain declared 156 kPa alternatives as diagnostics.
